query:
SELECT 
  sp.id as seller_profile_id,
  sp.user_id,
  sp.display_name,
  sp.is_active,
  sp.stripe_connect_status,
  mo.id as order_id,
  mo.order_no,
  mo.seller_id as order_seller_id,
  mo.order_status,
  mo.seller_type
FROM seller_profiles sp
LEFT JOIN marketplace_orders mo ON mo.seller_id = sp.id
WHERE mo.order_status IN ('processing', 'payment_received', 'paid_held')
LIMIT 20;
